messages:
lara: Quick UX check — noticed the help drawer labels 'Guides' while the docs site uses 'Docs' and the console search returns both. Feels inconsistent for new users. matt: Good catch. Where exactly? screenshot? lara: In the console top-right help button -> opens side panel titled 'Guides'. The article headers say 'Docs' and search autocomplete suggests 'Documentation'. jess: Ugh, that's the lexicon drift we talked about in last sprint. Users search for 'docs' not 'guides'. aria: Also seen in onboarding tour: step 2 says 'Open Guides' and step 4 says 'read Docs'. Confusing for support calls. oliver: tagging @docbot to surface where term variants appear across repo and docs site docbot: found 14 occurrences: 9 in docs site (Documentation/Docs), 3 in console UI (Guides), 2 in onboarding copy (Guides/Docs mix). Exported CSV to /shared/design/lexicon-scan.csv lara: Nice. Can we pick a single surface term? My vote: "Docs" — it's what other platforms use and is clear. matt: Agree on 'Docs'. 'Guides' reads more like tutorials, which we also have. Might keep 'Guides' as a subsection name. jess: Proposal: top-level nav + help button = 'Docs'. Inside we have subsections: 'Guides' (tutorials), 'API reference', 'Runbook'. aria: UX nit: change help panel title and search placeholder from "Search Guides" to "Search Docs". Also update alt text for help icon. oliver: I'll draft microcopy and list of strings to change. Will also add redirect links so deep links to old /guides/ slug still work. lara: Awesome. Also need cross-links from docs articles back into console where relevant (e.g., link from 'model routing' doc to console routing config panel). Current links are to docs site only. matt: We should add an in-panel 'jump to console' CTA for admin users. Small button that opens the exact route. jess: Accessibility check — make sure the CTA has aria-describedby and that panel focus management keeps keyboard context. aria: Adding to the checklist: update i18n keys, update telemetry tag for search clicks (so we can measure drop in confusion), and update unit tests that assert header copy. oliver: Will send PR with copy + list of selectors to change. @matt can you own the console code change? @jess can you run a quick a11y sweep? matt: Yup taking it. ETA EOD Thursday for the UI changes, will include automated smoke test. jess: I can review a11y Friday morning. lara: Perfect. For rollout, let's do a canary for 10% of orgs and monitor search success rate for the term "docs" vs "guides". aria: Reminder: update the release notes and changelog pre-merge so support isn't surprised. oliver: PR link once ready: https://git.redwood/repo/changes/PR-482 docbot: added task cards to #product board: Update help lexicon, Add console crosslinks, Accessibility sweep, Telemetry update lara: Thanks team :thumbsup: matt: Thanks — will post a follow-up with screenshots when PR is ready. aria: If anyone wants the lexicon spreadsheet ping me, I can share a filtered view. jess: Adding a quick example to the PR of the new panel title and the CTA markup: ```

Docs

Opens the corresponding console page in a new tab

``` oliver: love that. closing loop after PR review."
